title: Agent Runtime & Orchestration
description: Frameworks and systems for running agents, coordinating workflows, and composing autonomous software teams.
include_when: The repo is primarily about agent execution, orchestration, multi-agent workflows, or agent operating systems.

title: Codex, Claude & Skill Workflows
description: Codex/Claude setups, skills, harnesses, prompt packs, and AI coding workflow methods.
include_when: The repo is mainly about Codex, Claude Code, skills, prompt workflows, status lines, or AI coding operating practices.

title: MCP & Tool Integrations
description: Model Context Protocol servers and connectors for external services, IDEs, knowledge systems, and productivity tools.
include_when: The repo exposes an MCP server/client, connects agents to SaaS tools, or wraps external APIs for agent use.

title: RAG, Retrieval & Search
description: Retrieval-augmented generation, semantic retrieval, vector search, sparse search, and agent search layers.
include_when: The primary value is retrieval quality, search infrastructure, vector/sparse indexing, or RAG application patterns.

title: Memory & Context Systems
description: Long-term memory, context management, context retrieval, and reusable agent memory stores.
include_when: The repo manages persistent memory, context windows, personal/team memory, or reusable agent context.

title: Knowledge Graphs
description: Graph-backed memory, knowledge graph construction, graph retrieval, and entity/relation systems for AI agents.
include_when: The repo centers on graph data structures, knowledge graphs, graph construction, or graph retrieval.

title: Evals, Observability & Prompt Ops
description: Evaluation, tracing, prompt management, observability, metrics, and quality gates for LLM applications.
include_when: The repo helps measure, trace, compare, audit, or manage LLM/application behavior.

title: Documents, OCR & Parsing
description: PDF/OCR/document parsing, document-to-markdown conversion, and content extraction for agent workflows.
include_when: The primary work is extracting structured or LLM-ready data from files, PDFs, images, archives, or documents.

title: Cloudflare, Edge & Backend
description: Cloudflare Workers, edge runtimes, backend platforms, serverless systems, and deployment infrastructure.
include_when: The repo is backend/edge/serverless infrastructure or specifically targets Cloudflare.

title: Databases, Storage & SQLite
description: Databases, SQLite extensions, storage engines, query systems, and data persistence layers.
include_when: The repo primarily implements or wraps a database, storage layer, query engine, or SQLite extension.

title: Frontend, UI, Desktop & Browser Automation
description: Frontend frameworks, desktop apps, UI layers, design tools, browser automation, and visual agent interfaces.
include_when: The repo is mainly a UI/UX surface, desktop/browser tool, frontend agent UI, or visual automation layer.

title: Developer Tools & CLI
description: CLI tools, code assistants, log tools, LSP integrations, OpenAPI wrappers, and developer workflow utilities.
include_when: The repo is a developer-facing command-line, IDE, code, log, LSP, terminal, or workflow utility.

title: Learning, Guides & Awesome Lists
description: Curated lists, tutorials, guides, examples, and structured learning resources.
include_when: The repo is mostly educational, reference-oriented, or a curated list rather than a runtime/tool.

title: Research, Papers & Science
description: Research projects, paper implementations, arXiv tooling, experiments, and scientific/research workflows.
include_when: The repo is primarily tied to research papers, arXiv, experiments, or academic implementations.

title: Security, Safety & Supply Chain
description: Security scanners, safe execution systems, supply-chain checks, and isolation/sandboxing tools.
include_when: The repo helps detect risk, isolate execution, scan packages, or make agent workflows safer.

title: Communications & Personal Ops
description: Messaging, personal productivity, career ops, and communication automation connected to agents.
include_when: The repo connects agent workflows to messaging, inboxes, career workflows, or personal operations.

title: Uncategorized / Needs Review
description: Useful but weakly described repositories that need manual review before public positioning.
include_when: The metadata is too thin or the project does not fit the current taxonomy.
